verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. The Lean h_σ is `pairScales kappa ci P j = kappa * ci j * mass (P j).ψ (P j).x`, instantiated at `kappa = PartitionedCovariance.nativePrefactor vr vt r0` (used that way at PrimaryCovarianceBounds.lean:312 and :405). Unfolding the two definitions gives (|det(v_r,v_t)|/2)·(∫ χ^2 dξ)·c_i·∫_ℝ ψ^2 x^2 dv, which is the paper's formula except that the transverse integral runs over all of ℝ rather than [0, L_s]. The two integrals are equal: `PulseBounds.cutoff_zero` forces ψ = 0 off Icc (r^2/6) (5r^2/6) ⊂ [0, r^2] = [0, L_s], which is the same support argument the Lean uses in `actualColumn_eq_intervalIntegral` (PulseCovariance.lean:578) to pass from the ℝ-integral to ∫_0^{r^2}. No constant, exponent, sign or variable range differs.
